description: Tracks the value, validity and interaction state (`touched`, `dirty`) of one field.
A keyed collection of controls; its value is an object and it is invalid when any child is invalid.
Injectable shortcut for creating controls and groups. `fb.nonNullable` makes controls reset to their initial value instead of `null`.
Directive connecting an input to a control of the parent `[formGroup]` by key.
`setValue` needs every key of the group; `patchValue` updates only the provided keys.
Observables that emit when the value or validity changes. Convert with `toSignal()` for signal-based templates.
